Would your AI agent's ROI number survive three questions?

Most ROI numbers come from the same company running the agent.

They decide what counts as resolved, hold the raw logs, and hand finance a percentage. 👀

That is not fraud. It is just an unaudited number dressed up as a fact.

A real number survives three questions. Who decided. Who can see the logs. Who benefits. 🧠

Save this before your next board review, and ask agentworth for a number with a source trail. 💡
